note: Coefficients for business modules. 'literature' coefficients must stay inside their published range ('ranges', checked by the engine and tests); 'labelled_default' are uncalibrated scale or neutral choices with no published range; 'heuristic' are practice values from general business sense. Nothing here comes from any game. Not a forecast.

sources: Cooper & Nakanishi 1988 (MCI: one multiplicative term with its own elasticity per instrument, eq. 2.7)
demand chain ad_elasticity (data/demand_literature.json): Sethuraman, Tellis & Briesch 2011, short-term mean 0.12 (median 0.05), long-term mean 0.24 (median 0.10)

media_weights.why: No published general ranking of local, regional, social and search media; equal weights are the neutral choice until Q2+ data.

sources: Albers, Mantrala & Sridhar 2010, JMR 47(5): mean current-period personal-selling elasticity 0.34, about 0.31 after method-bias correction (506 estimates; abstract verified; dispersion not verified)
constant-elasticity response as in the meta-analysis

force_reference.why: Scale of the force per market at which the response is (1+1)^e; chosen for the synthetic pack.

sources: direction only: Griffeth, Hom & Gaertner 2000, pay vs turnover rho about -0.09 (-0.12 in 1990s studies), no elasticity
candidate for the next step: Farrell & Hakstian 2001 (23.1% productivity gain from training, 12 effect sizes; seen as abstract snippet only, not verified)

costs (hire_cost, severance_cost).why: The game's sales-force cost rule was not observed.

sources: Azzi, Battini, Faccio, Persona & Sgarbossa 2014, Int. J. Logistics Management 25(1), literature review quoting Stock & Lambert 1993 (12-34%) and Schonberger & Knod 1997 / Pyke & Cohen 1994 (20-50%) of inventory value per year (introduction verified)

salvage_fraction.why: No published general salvage rate (Cachon & Kok 2007 is about estimating it, not a value).

discount_tiers.why: No published typical discount magnitudes; tiers chosen for the synthetic pack's production volume.
